newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RED WINGS RE-SIGN FREE AGENT CENTER LARIONOV.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RED WINGS RE-SIGN FREE AGENT CENTER LARIONOV.

text.p: After falling short in the bidding for free agent centre Mark Messier, the Detroit Red Wings have re-signed unrestricted free agent centre Igor Larionov to a three-year contract.
Terms were not disclosed, but published reports put the value of the deal at $5.5 million.

The 36-year-old Larionov is part of a large Russian contingent that helped the Red Wings win the Stanley Cup for the first time in 42 years this past season. He had 12 goals and 42 assists in 64 games and added four goals and eight assists in 20 postseason contests.
Larionov was acquired by Detroit from the San Jose Sharks in November 1995. He had 21 goals and 50 assists in 69 games for the Red Wings in 1995-96.

The Russian, who began his NHL career with Vancouver, has compiled 107 goals and 243 assists for 350 points in 440 career games. Larionov was a four-time Soviet National League All-Star and was named the 1988 Soviet Player of the Year while with the Central Red Army team.
